bugs.name: Page Not Found recovery link leaves the visitor on the same page
bugs.summary: The Go back to the previous page recovery link on Page Not Found leaves the visitor on the same error page.
bugs.expected: The recovery link should navigate away from Page Not Found.
bugs.actual: The Go back to the previous page recovery link on Page Not Found leaves the visitor on the same error page.
reproSteps: Open a nonexistent public status-page URL while signed out.
Wait for the Page Not Found screen.
Click Go back to the previous page and observe whether the browser leaves the error page.
bugs.reason: Mo excludes Back-button reports reached by opening a mid-flow URL directly without prior in-app navigation history. These steps directly open a nonexistent URL and then click Go back to the previous page; they do not establish the history required to return to a previous page. This is the navigation-history exclusion, independent of source evidence for expected or actual behavior.

bugs.name: General settings labels focus unrelated controls
bugs.summary: Chrome/Chromium Executable and Server Timezone labels focus other settings, so users who click a label can edit an unrelated value.
bugs.expected: The executable label focuses its executable input; Server Timezone focuses the server timezone dropdown.
bugs.actual: Typing after clicking Chrome/Chromium Executable changes Primary Base URL while the executable stays blank. Clicking Server Timezone focuses Display Timezone. The actions were reproduced after reload, without saving the unintended changes.
reproSteps: Sign in, open Settings > General (/settings/general), and wait for settings to load.
Click the Chrome/Chromium Executable label and type /usr/bin/chromium using the keyboard.
Observe the Primary Base URL and executable fields.
Reload without saving, then click the Server Timezone label.
bugs.reason: All reported behavior is label-triggered focus movement to unrelated controls followed by keyboard entry. The supplied policy explicitly excludes focus movement and convention-based label association. No independent stated product rule overrides it; not_a_bug under these rules.
